Harper Lin: Heads-up  Priyanka S. is taking the overnight train and arrives at Penn Station 5:45am for a 7:30am onsite loop. Need logistics: early building access, lactation room, and ASL interpreter.
Diego Ramos: earliest building access is 6:30am weekdays. Front desk can badge earlier with escort. Do we want to open a quiet prep room?
Harper Lin: yes please. Candidate asked if they can rest for ~45m before the interview. Also explicitly requested on-site ASL interpreter (certified).
Sofia K.: we have a contract with ASL Services vendor. I can request interpreter for 7:15-10:00am. Approve cost? Estimate $160/hr + travel.
Diego Ramos: approved for vendor up to $600 for whole slot. Please submit vendor payment ticket.
Reception: After-hours protocol: for arrivals before 7am, Escort required. Please meet at West Lobby at 6:25am. Call desk at +1-555-210-3344 on arrival. We'll pre-print a visitor badge.
People Ops Bot: Badge request created for Priyanka Sharma. Badge ETA: 10m after check-in. Note: lactation room keycode will be generated and shared to meeting attendees only.
ASL Services: Confirmed availability: certified ASL interpreter (M. Ortega) booked 7:15-10:00am. Will arrive 7:00am to meet candidate.
Harper Lin: thank you. Can someone pick up from Penn if train delayed? ETA plan?
Diego Ramos: if delayed >30m, we'll switch to remote interview. Zoom backup already added. I can reroute panelists.
Sofia K.: booking quiet prep room: Conf D1 reserved 6:30-7:30am. Lactation room reserved 6:30-11:00am; keycode will be in the calendar invite.
Reception: On arrival, candidate should text "Priyanka S - arrived" to +1-555-210-3344 for expedited badge pickup. We'll supply a small welcome kit and bottled water.
Harper Lin: travel reimbursement note: if they take taxi or rideshare, forward receipt to expenses@redwood.ai with subject "Candidate Travel - Priyanka Sharma - [date]". Reimb within 3 business days. If vendor car used, finance ticket required.
People Ops Bot: Expense template reminder: ["Expense Type: Candidate Travel", "Amount: $XX", "Candidate: Priyanka Sharma", "Approver: Harper Lin"]. Create vendor-payment ticket for ASL Services under code: VENDOR-ASL-01.
Diego Ramos: catering: light breakfast (GF + dairy-free) for candidate and interpreter. Kitchen to deliver at 6:40am to Conf D1.
Sofia K.: calendar invite updated: 6:25am meet West Lobby, 7:30am interview start, Zoom fallback included, lactation room + ASL interpreter noted in description.
Reception: We'll have the lactation room sign and a folding screen ready near Conf D1. Also reserved a quiet stall restroom near the lobby for quick access.
Harper Lin: I'll DM the candidate the meet spot, Reception number, and ask for any mobility needs. Also requested a copy of ASL certification; vendor has that.
ASL Services: Interpreter will bring certification and ID. Please confirm escort name for the 6:25am meet.
Diego Ramos: I'll meet and escort at 6:25am.
Harper Lin: great. Closing the loop  ping here if anything changes. :white_check_mark:
People Ops Bot: This thread will auto-archive in 7 days per channel retention policy.
